title: Quake II demo 3.14, OpenGL — id Software, 1998
author: id Software
notes: id Software's Quake II demo of March 1998, with its OpenGL renderer: quake2.exe loads ref_gl.dll, which loads opengl32.dll itself and asks it for each OpenGL function by GetProcAddress; MIRAGE-WIN32 makes opengl32.dll in JavaScript and PRISM's gl.js draws on WebGL2. The rest as in the software version: its own DLLs mapped as Windows does, DirectSound, Winsock on an empty network, the licence beside it.
